'''Coynite battle armor''' was a type of [[Battle armor|armor]]. This bulky suit included a helmet and was made from the stands of [[walt'sor plant]]s, found only on [[Coyn]]. Despite the suit's rather humble origins, it provided excellent protection against physical and energy attacks.

Typically, Coynite battle armor was not available to offworlders, though it was in high demand among [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxers]] and other participants in high-contact sporting events.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]] incorrectly lists the '''Coynite battle armor''' at the low price of 150 credits, the same cost as [[D'skar]] dagger. Both [[The Star Wars Planets Collection]] and its precursor [[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]] list the price at 3000 credits.
